definitions.successfulWarmSamples: status=ok, temperature=warm; all warmup/cold/error records retained separately
definitions.terminalPhase: phase => /journal seal and OCC verification|authoritative publication/.test(phase)
definitions.percentiles: Arithmetic median; p95 descriptive nearest rank
definitions.sqlFamilies: A group counts once for each fx_ physical table named in its normalized template. Families overlap; they are diagnostics, not an additive query decomposition.

interpretation: Whole structural counts use every successful traced sample, including warmups and cold samples; every failed sample remains visible and fails full-series acceptance. Latency acceptance uses the independent untraced warm series. The retained slice17 mixed fixture omitted initial authentication and renewal, so matched settings are not equivalent authenticated semantics. Nested phase, transaction and driver-await intervals overlap; no CPU, server, transport, lock or connection causal subtraction follows.
unavailable: PostgreSQL server execution time (driver await includes transport and scheduling).
Exact native workflow child inclusive/exclusive spans; native steps are not instrumented, so SQL owner mapping is used instead.

Sealed attempt bytes for failed attempts and standalone workflow; settled journal rows are removed, so inventory separately records only remaining live journal bytes.

Client SQL that loses trace context during an active invocation is detected and invalidates that sample, but SQL through uninstrumented pools or outside the invocation cannot be counted; named phase checks do not prove universal SQL coverage.
